name: 前期間と重ねる二系列グラフ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual catalog component only, no dashboard or presentation board.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL source images have priority for icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, small controls and visible states. Native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese adaptation and isolated component composition; correct its rough substitutes and omissions against the original. The approved bus image is a style reference only, not content.
Official Lighthouse design: pure-white#FFFFFFpage/canvas; white surfaces; fine neutral borders and restrained soft shadow only where a real container exists. Forest-green brand#1F6444with smooth#174C36to#2D8F5Egradient on actual primary/selected controls. Supporting icons coherent slate#526173, no random decorative hues. Use only evidence-backed semantic accents. No broad mint wash, glow or plastic gloss. Preserve Japanese Meiryo typography: headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadataRegular12/16, zero tracking; retain role-specific distinctions and normal-weight body. Preserve all actual values, content, controls, artwork and visible states. Do not invent metrics, features, logos or watermark. Apple Design: purpose, compact readable hierarchy, precise alignment, clear state and restrained material. This static raster does not prove interaction, editability or owner acceptance.
Input roles: Image1: original-source-primary-details; Image2: component-preview-secondary; Image3: approved-style-reference
One two-period comparison chart,640x280logical landscape. Preserve actual ORIGINAL sparse line data, do not create decorative trends. Plot y-axis labels4,3,2,1,0 and fine neutral horizontal grid, baseline0. X-axis Japanese labels11月16日 /11月30日 /12月16日, spaced as native adaptation. Current series: zero fromNov16throughDec11, triangle to1atDec12 then zeroDec13, zero throughDec15, then DOTTED rising segment to3atDec16. Previous series: zero throughDec12, triangle to1atDec13 then zeroDec14, endingzero. Source dotted current final rise is visibly real detail omitted by mock; restore exact dotted pattern without inventing a forecast label. Thin strokes, no area fills or large markers. Source controls peak positions, unit heights, lineweight and final dotted tail. Use currentforestgreen#1F6444 and previouscoherentsecondaryblue#4B78B8 so two series remain distinguishable, not two near-identical greens. Bottom legend exactly 今回の利用者 withgreen dot, 前回の利用者 withblue dot. Restore small source previous/next square navigation buttons beneath plot at left/right: left enabledslatechevron onwhite, right disabledlightgray, consistent outline geometry. No other toolbar, summarymetric, charttitle, rows or controls. All labelsMeiryoRegular12/16zero tracking, neutralgray, no bold. White rounded quiet surface, subtle edge/elevation, no mintgrid orglow. Keep all5ylabels,3dates,2legenditemsand2navigationbuttons fully visible. Dotted tail meaning remains unspecified; preserve visible state only.
Evidence-based accent decision: Original blue/yellowgreen distinguish two actual periods. Adapt currenttoforestgreen, previouscoherentblue#4B78B8 for clear separation. Same colors inlinesandlegend; neutralgrid, no extra hue. Dotted final currentsegment preserved as visible detail without guessed meaning.
reviewNotes: 原画の2系列、1の二つのピーク、末尾3までの点線、左右ナビ・2凡例・日本語軸を復元し目視。森林緑と青で期間区別。ただし横軸の11月16日〜12月16日間隔に照らし、生成ピークと点線開始位置が原画より約1日早い。原画の今回12月12日/前回12月13日/点線12月15日→16日へ限定補正する。所有者承認・編集可能性・実装未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
